name: wildfire-simulator
description: Canadian FBP System wildfire spread and fire behaviour simulator for municipal EOC planning, preparedness and training (FastAPI + React/MapLibre). FBP verified against cffdrs; not yet validated against observed fires.

paragraphs: Fire growth, fire behaviour and building exposure from the Canadian Forest Fire Behavior Prediction (FBP) System, built for municipal Emergency Operations Centre (EOC) planning, preparedness and training in the wildland-urban interface.

equations are verified against the CFS reference implementation and its spread against WISE on uniform fuel. A first validation against observed Alberta fires (docs/validation.md) shows modest one-day skill with over-prediction, like WISE with default settings. Do not use its output as an operational prediction or as the basis for evacuation decisions. See the model card and verification and limits.
features: Intended use (now): preparedness, training, exercises and what-if planning. FireSim's FBP
